episodes.synopsis: Ace gamer Fumiya Tomozaki has given up on the “garbage game” of life, until a classmate offers to teach him the rules of this ultimate god-tier game.
episodes.title: Say what you want; famous games are usually fun

episodes.synopsis: Hinami tasks Tomozaki with starting and joining conversations; after his first few attempts fall flat, he comes away with some astute observations.
episodes.title: It feels awesome to gain a bunch of levels after a battle

episodes.synopsis: With Hinami’s help, Tomozaki gets a crash course in dressing well and talking to girls, getting unexpectedly close to one classmate in particular.
episodes.title: When a girl’s your first friend, life feels like a date for a while

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki begins tutoring Izumi in his favorite game, comes clean to Kikuchi, and gets roped into playing against the vengeful Nakamura after school.
episodes.title: Sometimes you conquer a dungeon only to find a strong boss back in your village

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki makes a new friend, then goes on a shopping trip for Nakamura’s birthday—of all things. Naturally, Hinami turns it into a teaching moment.
episodes.title: The characters who become your friends after you clear a hard event usually have high stats

episodes.synopsis: The student council election is approaching, and Tomozaki joins Mimimi’s campaign. Turns out they both have their reasons for wanting to beat Hinami.
episodes.title: Once you start speedrunning the minigames, you seriously can’t stop

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki brings his gamer’s cunning to Mimimi’s campaign speech—but Hinami’s a gamer, too. Tama tells Tomozaki how she and Mimimi became friends.
episodes.title: When a mentor character becomes a boss, they’ll push you to the edge

episodes.synopsis: Mimimi’s at her breaking point. A deeper dive into her past reveals why she’s so driven to beat Hinami, while Hinami’s motivation remains a mystery.
episodes.title: There are some problems a bottom-tier character can’t fix alone

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki rehearses with Hinami to prepare for his movie date with Kikuchi and is invited to an overnight barbecue with his popular normie classmates.
episodes.title: When you go back to the starter town with the full party, new stuff tends to happen

episodes.synopsis: Tomozaki gets a taste of the traditional overnight normie camp activities he’d always shunned as the group plots to get Izumi and Nakamura together.
episodes.title: Multiplayer games have their own special appeal

episodes.synopsis: An overheard conversation between Mizusawa and Hinami gives Tomozaki a different perspective on his private lessons in conquering the game of life.
episodes.title: A single choice can change everything

episodes.synopsis: A talk with Kikuchi helps Tomozaki realize what he really wants, and a confrontation with Hinami sets the course for the future of their relationship.
episodes.title: Equipment for girls has special effects
